de.fix: Für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen und am Ende über den Anfang hinaus weiterfahren, bis die Spur ihn kreuzt.
de.help: Am Ende der Aufnahme ist der Mäher nicht in Fahrtrichtung über den Anfang der Linie gefahren. Das Stück zwischen Ende und Anfang wurde dann nie gefahren. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Anfang nicht überfahren

en.fix: For the exact edge, record again and at the end drive on past the start until the track crosses it.
en.help: At the end of the recording the mower didn't drive over the start of the line along its heading, so the piece between the end and the start was never driven. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Start not driven over

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche durchgehend vorwärts neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Ein Stück der Linie liegt nicht in Fahrtrichtung des Mähers, etwa nach Rückwärtsfahren oder einem seitlichen Versatz. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Nicht in Fahrtrichtung

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again driving forward all the way.
en.help: A piece of the line doesn't follow the heading of the mower, for example after reversing or a step sideways. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Not along the heading

de.fix: Langsamer fahren und für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Zwischen zwei Punkten oder vom letzten zum ersten Punkt liegen mehr als 30 cm. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Lücke in der Linie

en.fix: Drive more slowly and record again for the exact edge.
en.help: Two points, or the last and the first point, are more than 30 cm apart. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Gap in the line

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche ohne Unterbrechung vorwärts neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Die automatischen Punkte waren zwischendurch aus, Punkte wurden mit Rückgängig entfernt, oder die Position war ungenau, fehlte oder sprang. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Aufnahme unterbrochen

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again driving forward without a break.
en.help: Automatic points were off for a while, points were undone, or the position was inaccurate, missing or jumped. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Recording interrupted

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche mit automatischen Punkten vorwärts neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Mindestens ein Punkt wurde von Hand gesetzt. Dann ist nicht belegt, dass der Mäher die Linie vorwärts gefahren ist. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Punkte von Hand

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again driving forward with automatic points.
en.help: At least one point was set by hand, so nothing shows that the mower drove the line forward. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Points set by hand

de.fix: Erst einige Meter geradeaus fahren, dann für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Beim Aufnehmen kannte der Mäher seine Fahrtrichtung noch nicht. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Richtung unbekannt

en.fix: Drive straight for a few metres first, then record again for the exact edge.
en.help: The mower didn't know its heading yet while recording. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Heading unknown

de.fix: Für den genauen Rand die Fläche ohne Rückwärtsfahren neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Beim Aufnehmen ist der Mäher rückwärts gefahren. Die Punkte davor wurden zurückgenommen, die Linie ist dort aber nicht in einem Zug vorwärts gefahren. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Rückwärts gefahren

en.fix: For the exact edge, record the area again without reversing.
en.help: The mower reversed while recording. The points ahead of it were taken back, but the line wasn't driven forward in one go there. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Reversed

de.fix: Kehren als Bogen fahren und für den genauen Rand neu aufnehmen.
de.help: Die Linie knickt an einer Stelle um mehr als 120 Grad. Dort ist nicht sicher, in welche Richtung sich der Mäher gedreht hat. Die Fläche wird normal gemäht, nur ohne den genauen Rand.
de.name: Zu spitze Kehre

en.fix: Drive turns as a curve and record again for the exact edge.
en.help: The line turns by more than 120 degrees at one spot, where it isn't certain which way the mower turned. The area is mowed as usual, only without the exact edge.
en.name: Turn too sharp

de.fix: Die Sicht zwischen Mäher und Station freimachen.
de.help: Der Marker der Ladestation war auf dem Weg hinein zu lange nicht zu sehen. Der Mäher hat angehalten und den Versuch beendet.
de.name: Marker verloren

en.fix: Clear the view between the mower and the station.
en.help: The marker of the docking station was out of sight for too long on the way in. The mower stopped and ended the attempt.
en.name: Marker lost

de.fix: Die Station neu aufnehmen oder die Kalibrierung der Kamera prüfen.
de.help: Der Marker steht nicht dort, wo die Ladestation in der Karte aufgenommen ist. Der Mäher dockt dann weder nach der Kamera noch nach der Position an.
de.name: Marker passt nicht zur Karte

en.fix: Record the station again or check the calibration of the camera.
en.help: The marker is not where the docking station was recorded in the map. The mower then docks neither by camera nor by its position.
en.name: Marker does not match the map

de.fix: Marker freimachen und säubern; bei Dunkelheit prüfen, ob die Station Strom hat und die Beleuchtung des Markers an ist; prüfen, ob die Station am aufgenommenen Platz steht.
de.help: Die Kamera läuft, sieht den Marker der Ladestation aber nicht. Der Mäher dockt dann nicht nach der Position an.
de.name: Marker nicht gefunden

en.fix: Clear and clean the marker; in the dark check that the station has power and the marker light is on; check that the station stands where it was recorded.
en.help: The camera is running but does not see the marker of the docking station. The mower does not dock by its position then.
en.name: Marker not found

de.fix: Kamera und ihre Einrichtung prüfen; das Detail nennt den Grund.
de.help: Die Kamera zur Ladestation kann den Marker gerade nicht messen.
de.name: Dock-Kamera misst nicht

en.fix: Check the camera and its setup; the detail names the cause.
en.help: The camera towards the docking station cannot measure the marker right now.
en.name: Dock camera not measuring

de.fix: Mäher näher, gerade und mittig vor die Ladestation stellen und den Test neu starten.
de.help: Der Mäher steht für den Andocktest nicht passend vor der Ladestation; die Meldung nennt den Grund. Das ist kein Fehler der Hardware.
de.name: Andocktest abgelehnt

en.fix: Place the mower closer, straight and centered in front of the docking station and start the test again.
en.help: The mower does not stand right in front of the docking station for the docking test; the message names the reason. This is no fault of the hardware.
en.name: Docking test refused

client.description: Who sent the command (app, ha), for the log and the events of its step

current.description: The charge current seen; while docking the largest one of the check

detail.description: With a cause of the dock camera: why it gave no measurement

de.fix: Warten, bis das Messer steht.
de.help: Diese Kamera zeigt kein Bild, solange das Messer läuft.
de.name: Messer läuft

en.fix: Wait until the blade has stopped.
en.help: This camera shows no picture while the blade runs.
en.name: Blade running

de.fix: Die Linse säubern.
de.name: Bild unscharf

en.fix: Clean the lens.
en.name: The image is blurred

de.fix: Kurz warten. Bleibt es dabei, MowBite OS neu starten.
de.help: Die Kamera kennt den Zustand des Mähers nicht und zeigt deshalb kein Bild.
de.name: Mäher meldet sich nicht

en.fix: Wait a moment. If it stays so, restart MowBite OS.
en.help: The camera doesn't know the state of the mower and so shows no picture.
en.name: Mower not reporting

de.name: Marker gefunden, Lage nicht sicher messbar

en.name: The marker was found, but its position could not be measured reliably

de.fix: Das Protokoll für eine Meldung sichern. Die Sperre nur nach der Anleitung löschen.
de.help: Das Betriebssystem des Mähers ist abgestürzt, während diese Kamera lief. Sie bleibt aus, bis die Sperre auf dem Mäher gelöscht ist.
de.name: Kamera gesperrt

en.fix: Keep the log for a report. Delete the lock only as the guide says.
en.help: The operating system of the mower crashed while this camera ran. It stays off until the lock on the mower is deleted.
en.name: Camera locked

de.fix: Nur einen Marker im Blick der Kamera lassen.
de.name: Mehr als ein Marker im Bild

en.fix: Leave only one marker in view of the camera.
en.name: More than one marker in the image
The marker touches the edge of the image

de.fix: Die Kamera nach der Anleitung einrichten.
de.help: Auf dem Mäher fehlt etwas, das diese Kamera braucht, zum Beispiel ein Modell oder der Dienst für das Livebild.
de.name: Kamera nicht eingerichtet

en.fix: Set the camera up as the guide says.
en.help: Something this camera needs is missing on the mower, for example a model or the service for the live picture.
en.name: Camera not set up

de.fix: Kurz warten. Bleibt es dabei, MowBite OS neu starten.
de.help: Die Kamera liefert gerade kein Bild.
de.name: Kein Bild

en.fix: Wait a moment. If it stays so, restart MowBite OS.
en.help: The camera gives no picture right now.
en.name: No picture

de.fix: Warten, bis der Test durch ist.
de.help: Die Kamera prüft sich nach dem Start einmal selbst. Das geht nur, wenn der Mäher steht und das Messer aus ist.
de.name: Selbsttest

en.fix: Wait until the test is done.
en.help: The camera tests itself once after the start. That only works while the mower stands with the blade off.
en.name: Self-test

de.fix: Blendung vermeiden, etwa tief stehende Sonne oder eine Lampe hinter der Station.
de.name: Bild zu hell

en.fix: Avoid glare, such as a low sun or a lamp behind the station.
en.name: The image is too bright

de.fix: Prüfen, ob die Station Strom hat und die Beleuchtung des Markers an ist; sonst für Licht an der Station sorgen.
de.name: Bild zu dunkel

en.fix: Check that the station has power and the marker light is on; otherwise provide light at the station.
en.name: The image is too dark

de.fix: Warten, bis er abgekühlt ist.
de.help: Der Rechner des Mähers ist zu warm, die Kamera macht eine Pause.
de.name: Zu warm

en.fix: Wait until it has cooled down.
en.help: The computer of the mower is too hot, so the camera pauses.
en.name: Too hot

de.fix: Die Sicht zwischen Mäher und Station freimachen.
de.help: Der Marker der Ladestation war auf dem Weg hinein zu lange nicht zu sehen. Der Mäher hat angehalten und den Versuch beendet.
de.name: Marker verloren

en.fix: Clear the view between the mower and the station.
en.help: The marker of the docking station was out of sight for too long on the way in. The mower stopped and ended the attempt.
en.name: Marker lost

de.fix: Die Station neu aufnehmen oder die Kalibrierung der Kamera prüfen.
de.help: Der Marker steht nicht dort, wo die Ladestation in der Karte aufgenommen ist. Der Mäher dockt dann weder nach der Kamera noch nach der Position an.
de.name: Marker passt nicht zur Karte

en.fix: Record the station again or check the calibration of the camera.
en.help: The marker is not where the docking station was recorded in the map. The mower then docks neither by camera nor by its position.
en.name: Marker does not match the map

de.fix: Marker freimachen und säubern; bei Dunkelheit prüfen, ob die Station Strom hat und die Beleuchtung des Markers an ist; prüfen, ob die Station am aufgenommenen Platz steht.
de.help: Die Kamera läuft, sieht den Marker der Ladestation aber nicht. Der Mäher dockt dann nicht nach der Position an.
de.name: Marker nicht gefunden

en.fix: Clear and clean the marker; in the dark check that the station has power and the marker light is on; check that the station stands where it was recorded.
en.help: The camera is running but does not see the marker of the docking station. The mower does not dock by its position then.
en.name: Marker not found

de.fix: Kamera und ihre Einrichtung prüfen; das Detail nennt den Grund.
de.help: Die Kamera zur Ladestation kann den Marker gerade nicht messen.
de.name: Dock-Kamera misst nicht

en.fix: Check the camera and its setup; the detail names the cause.
en.help: The camera towards the docking station cannot measure the marker right now.
en.name: Dock camera not measuring

de.fix: Mäher näher, gerade und mittig vor die Ladestation stellen und den Test neu starten.
de.help: Der Mäher steht für den Andocktest nicht passend vor der Ladestation; die Meldung nennt den Grund. Das ist kein Fehler der Hardware.
de.name: Andocktest abgelehnt

en.fix: Place the mower closer, straight and centered in front of the docking station and start the test again.
en.help: The mower does not stand right in front of the docking station for the docking test; the message names the reason. This is no fault of the hardware.
en.name: Docking test refused

detail.description: With a cause of the dock camera: why it gave no measurement

de.fix: Warten, bis das Messer steht.
de.help: Diese Kamera zeigt kein Bild, solange das Messer läuft.
de.name: Messer läuft

en.fix: Wait until the blade has stopped.
en.help: This camera shows no picture while the blade runs.
en.name: Blade running

de.fix: Die Linse säubern.
de.name: Bild unscharf

en.fix: Clean the lens.
en.name: The image is blurred

de.fix: Kurz warten. Bleibt es dabei, MowBite OS neu starten.
de.help: Die Kamera kennt den Zustand des Mähers nicht und zeigt deshalb kein Bild.
de.name: Mäher meldet sich nicht

en.fix: Wait a moment. If it stays so, restart MowBite OS.
en.help: The camera doesn't know the state of the mower and so shows no picture.
en.name: Mower not reporting

de.name: Marker gefunden, Lage nicht sicher messbar

en.name: The marker was found, but its position could not be measured reliably

de.fix: Das Protokoll für eine Meldung sichern. Die Sperre nur nach der Anleitung löschen.
de.help: Das Betriebssystem des Mähers ist abgestürzt, während diese Kamera lief. Sie bleibt aus, bis die Sperre auf dem Mäher gelöscht ist.
de.name: Kamera gesperrt

en.fix: Keep the log for a report. Delete the lock only as the guide says.
en.help: The operating system of the mower crashed while this camera ran. It stays off until the lock on the mower is deleted.
en.name: Camera locked

de.fix: Nur einen Marker im Blick der Kamera lassen.
de.name: Mehr als ein Marker im Bild

en.fix: Leave only one marker in view of the camera.
en.name: More than one marker in the image
The marker touches the edge of the image

de.fix: Die Kamera nach der Anleitung einrichten.
de.help: Auf dem Mäher fehlt etwas, das diese Kamera braucht, zum Beispiel ein Modell oder der Dienst für das Livebild.
de.name: Kamera nicht eingerichtet

en.fix: Set the camera up as the guide says.
en.help: Something this camera needs is missing on the mower, for example a model or the service for the live picture.
en.name: Camera not set up

de.fix: Kurz warten. Bleibt es dabei, MowBite OS neu starten.
de.help: Die Kamera liefert gerade kein Bild.
de.name: Kein Bild

en.fix: Wait a moment. If it stays so, restart MowBite OS.
en.help: The camera gives no picture right now.
en.name: No picture

de.fix: Warten, bis der Test durch ist.
de.help: Die Kamera prüft sich nach dem Start einmal selbst. Das geht nur, wenn der Mäher steht und das Messer aus ist.
de.name: Selbsttest

en.fix: Wait until the test is done.
en.help: The camera tests itself once after the start. That only works while the mower stands with the blade off.
en.name: Self-test

de.fix: Blendung vermeiden, etwa tief stehende Sonne oder eine Lampe hinter der Station.
de.name: Bild zu hell

en.fix: Avoid glare, such as a low sun or a lamp behind the station.
en.name: The image is too bright

de.fix: Prüfen, ob die Station Strom hat und die Beleuchtung des Markers an ist; sonst für Licht an der Station sorgen.
de.name: Bild zu dunkel

en.fix: Check that the station has power and the marker light is on; otherwise provide light at the station.
en.name: The image is too dark

de.fix: Warten, bis er abgekühlt ist.
de.help: Der Rechner des Mähers ist zu warm, die Kamera macht eine Pause.
de.name: Zu warm

en.fix: Wait until it has cooled down.
en.help: The computer of the mower is too hot, so the camera pauses.
en.name: Too hot

description: robot_state, actions, events and RPC methods of MowBite OS over MQTT, as system.api gives them; made from the code, objects sorted by key. x-reasons has severity and resume of every reason by event (COMMAND_REFUSED and REQUEST_REFUSED only in refusals; when: another rating for these field values; texts: name, help and fix by language; an enum field may carry the same by value as x-texts), x-emergency-bits the bits of emergency, x-commands the commands with params, result, the event of their refusal and the actions that do the same, x-methods every RPC method of the OS with its node (planner.* are the planner's, sim.* only in the simulation), x-sensors the sensors by id, x-settings the settings of params.set with the ranges of the OS, x-geometry the keys of robot.geometry, x-schedule-log the words of schedule.log with what detail and more hold (null: always null), x-setup the setup program. x-api counts every change, x-api-break only the breaks: a method, field, event, reason or topic gone or renamed, a type or meaning changed, a parameter newly required, fewer values taken in a request, an event a client waits for no longer sent. All else only adds; a client goes with every x-api of its x-api-break from the one it needs on.
title: MowBite OS app interface

docking.start.description: Drives home from IDLE to the docking station where the OS docks by itself; offered only there

docking.test.description: Docks by the dock camera alone from where the mower stands in front of the station, without map or position (the reason TEST at DOCKING); offered only where the platform has a dock marker

emergency.reset.description: Asks the safety node to release the emergency; answers once the emergency ended, or with the refusal of the safety node or STILL_ACTIVE with the bits that stay, after at most 5 s

mowing.abort.description: Ends mowing; the mower goes home where it docks by itself

mowing.continue.description: Continues mowing after a pause that waits for the user

mowing.reset_job.description: Drops the unfinished job in IDLE

mowing.start.description: Starts or continues the job of mowing from IDLE

recording.auto_points.description: Switches the automatic points of the ring on or off

recording.discard.description: Drops what was recorded and not saved

recording.dock.description: Records a point of the docking station: first in front of it, then on the contacts, where base_link of the docked mower becomes the position of the station; DOCK_RECORDED follows

recording.exit.description: Leaves the recording; what was not saved is gone

recording.point.description: Takes the next position as a point of the ring

recording.ring_start.description: Starts recording a ring: the outline, after it an obstacle

recording.ring_stop.description: Closes the ring being recorded; one without points just ends, one whose end ran past its start is cut at the crossing

recording.save.description: Saves the outline and its obstacles as an area, closing an open ring first; AREA_RECORDED follows

recording.start.description: Enters the recording of areas from IDLE

recording.undo.description: Takes points back from the end of the open ring and switches the automatic points off; the mower stays

calibration.abort.description: Stops the calibration drive where the mower is

docking.start.description: Drives home from IDLE to the docking station where the OS docks by itself; offered only there

emergency.reset.description: Asks the safety node to release the emergency; answers once the emergency ended, or with the refusal of the safety node or STILL_ACTIVE with the bits that stay, after at most 5 s

events.history.description: The events of one local day as events/json sent them

events.history.delete.description: Deletes the events of one day, without a day of all

host.restart_os.description: Starts MowBite OS again, its restarts from 0: always when it is stopped, down or halted, else only in IDLE without an emergency or the restart hold; never during an update. The restart hold judges at the start as always

incidents.delete.description: Deletes one incident, without an id all

incidents.download.description: An incident as a tar archive in pieces of at most 262144 bytes; without location the journal goes without place and with a shifted date

incidents.get.description: The manifest of an incident and its timeline of at most 65536 bytes

incidents.mark.description: Keeps the last 5 min as an incident with a note, as a report of the user

journal.status.description: What the journal of the OS keeps, and its incidents

light.get_profile.description: The lights: the states and effects there are, the profile by state, its defaults, the fixed signal of an emergency and the limits

light.preview.description: Shows an effect for a while, then the state again; an emergency shows over it

light.reset.description: Back to the default profile; ends a preview

light.set_profile.description: Stores the profile, all or nothing; a state left out gets its default

logs.recent.description: The last log lines from WARN on, oldest first, logins hidden

map.area_properties.description: The properties an area of the map may have

map.replace.description: Replaces the map with the one given, in the shape of map/json. With a second parameter {"expected_sha256": sha256 of the map/json text the client last read} another map stored meanwhile is not replaced (-32001 map changed meanwhile)

mowing.abort.description: Ends mowing; the mower goes home where it docks by itself

mowing.continue.description: Continues mowing after a pause that waits for the user

mowing.plan.description: Asks the planner for the paths of an area without mowing it

mowing.reset_job.description: Drops the unfinished job in IDLE

mowing.start.description: Starts or continues the job of mowing from IDLE

notify.get.description: The settings of the pushes; of the token only whether there is one

notify.push_add.description: A phone's UnifiedPush address; past 10 the oldest goes

notify.set.description: Changes settings, all or nothing: -32602 with data {field, reason}. A push says so to the targets of before

notify.snooze.description: No reminders for so long; 0 lifts it

notify.test.description: Sends a test push to the topic and the phones, or to one address

ntrip.get.description: The access to the caster for corrections, without user and password

ntrip.set.description: Stores the access in IDLE, all or nothing; a stored login stays only for the same host and port

params.set.description: Changes settings of x-settings in IDLE, all or nothing; a value outside its range is set to the bound

position.history.description: The track of a job of mowing

position.history.delete.description: Deletes the track of a job, without a job all but the current one

recording.auto_points.description: Switches the automatic points of the ring on or off

recording.discard.description: Drops what was recorded and not saved

recording.dock.description: Records a point of the docking station: first in front of it, then on the contacts, where base_link of the docked mower becomes the position of the station; DOCK_RECORDED follows

recording.exit.description: Leaves the recording; what was not saved is gone

recording.point.description: Takes the next position as a point of the ring

recording.ring_start.description: Starts recording a ring: the outline, after it an obstacle

recording.ring_stop.description: Closes the ring being recorded; one without points just ends, one whose end ran past its start is cut at the crossing

recording.save.description: Saves the outline and its obstacles as an area, closing an open ring first; AREA_RECORDED follows

recording.start.description: Enters the recording of areas from IDLE

recording.undo.description: Takes points back from the end of the open ring and switches the automatic points off; the mower stays

robot.geometry.get.description: The dimensions of the mower, keys of x-geometry

robot.geometry.set.description: Changes dimensions in IDLE, all or nothing; GEOMETRY_CHANGED follows. rpc.methods.description: The methods offered right now, of the OS and the planner

schedule.get.description: The schedule, whether it may start, the clock and the sun

schedule.leftovers.description: The leftovers after a job: enabled 1 is refused (-32602 unsupported) until the planner prepares them on the OS

schedule.log.description: The log of the schedule, oldest first; words in x-schedule-log

schedule.set.description: Changes keys of the schedule, all or nothing: -32602 with data {field, reason}, -32001 when version is not the one of the last schedule.get

sensors.history.description: Min, mean and max of the number sensors per step over the last 48 h; the answer stays below 900000 bytes: the step grows to 300 or 900, then the oldest points go

sensors.list.description: Every sensor of sensor_infos/json with its last value; ids selects some, unknown ids are left out

setup.abort.description: Ends the running step with STOPPED; nothing happens without one
setup.abort.offered: where the platform has a step list (setup/setup.yaml)

setup.answer.description: Gives the inputs of a step: a choice, a number, the answer to a question, the delays of a step inputs_assign that is ok

setup.get.description: The state of the setup program: the steps of the platform with their texts
setup.get.offered: where the platform has a step list (setup/setup.yaml)

setup.image.description: An image of a step in pieces of at most 65536 bytes
setup.image.offered: where the platform has a step list (setup/setup.yaml)

setup.keep.description: Keeps a step that moves the wheels going: at least every 1 s while it runs, else it stops with RELEASED. Not needed for other steps

setup.reset.description: Takes every result back: all steps are open again, the record starts anew. It takes the date, the stand time and allow_blade out of the parameter file of the program; a lock the program opened (safety.source program) closes with a reset until a summary passes again, a date from the file kept by hand stays as it is. setup.reset.offered: where the platform has a step list (setup/setup.yaml)

setup.skip.description: Skips a step that is skippable; it can be done later all the same. A skipped check never opens the lock of the safety measurement
setup.skip.offered: where the platform has a step list (setup/setup.yaml)

setup.start.description: Begins a step whose start is true, or repeats one that ended; a step of the check confirm ends with it. SETUP_STEP follows when it ends
setup.start.offered: where the platform has a step list (setup/setup.yaml)

sound.delete.description: Deletes the upload of a situation, so that the vendor's sound plays again, or none without one; nothing to delete is no error. -32004 while an update holds the mower
sound.delete.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.list.description: The situations the OS has a sound for, the sound of each and the volume
sound.list.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.play.description: Plays the sound of a situation once, to listen to it; refused (SOUND_REFUSED) in an emergency and without a sound (NO_FILE)
sound.play.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.stop.description: Ends the sound that plays; refused (SOUND_REFUSED) in an emergency
sound.stop.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.upload.description: Uploads an MP3 of at most 2 MB and 30 s for a situation in parts, one upload at a time, also in an emergency; part 0 starts it, the same file from part 0 starts it again. The OS checks it after the last part and only then plays it instead of the vendor's sound. Refused (SOUND_REFUSED) for a wrong file, order or size and while another upload runs; an unfinished upload is dropped 60 s after its last part; -32004 while an update holds the mower
sound.upload.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

sound.volume.description: Reads the volume, or sets it with volume; 0 is silent, also in an emergency. A change while an update holds the mower is refused with -32004
sound.volume.offered: with a speaker and at least one sound

stats.get.description: Mowing statistics per hour and the parts to see to

system.api.description: This interface as JSON Schema with its version

system.info.description: Name, version and platform of the OS with the versions of its data and of this interface

update.abort.description: Stops the update before its switch; after it the health check decides

update.check.description: Looks for bundles in the inbox now and asks the release index on the net in the background, as it does every 6 h; a bundle newer than what runs is downloaded, never installed by that

update.rollback.description: Goes back to the previous installation through the same gate, planner and app without an own one before to the bundled one, the host to its seed in the rootfs; that revision is then not installed by itself. NO_PREVIOUS on the bundled one or the seed

update.set_auto.description: Switches the automatic update on or off and sets its window; it needs an app as new as min_app. It takes the switch also without a sure clock, only the update in the window waits for one

update.set_channel.description: Chooses which releases of the index count: stable, or preview for previews as well; then asks the index

update.start.description: Installs the newest available revision of the component or the one given, one update at a time; os and planner wait for the gate (IDLE on the charging contacts, the hold granted) for up to 30 min, the planner also for the end of the mowing job, the app and the host for none. The host starts itself anew and gives the result once the new one confirmed itself after 60 s, else it goes back. Refused (UPDATE_REFUSED) when none is there or one runs

update.status.description: What the updater does and what is there; the same retained on mowbite/update/status

de.name: Zeitplan

en.fix: Nothing to do. The next plan goes on with the job.
en.help: The schedule ends mowing: the time of the plan is over, or its areas are paused.
en.name: Schedule

TURN_SLIDE.description: Turning on the spot, the mower slid too far from its place

de.fix: Fortsetzen, wenn es trockener ist, oder die Stelle auslassen.

STORAGE_NOT_WRITABLE.description: A file in data_dir cannot be written: nothing starts until it can

de.fix: Den Mäher neu starten. Bleibt es so, ist der Speicher voll oder defekt: das Protokoll für eine Meldung sichern.
de.help: Der Speicher des Mähers lässt sich nicht beschreiben. Starten ist gesperrt, bis das Schreiben wieder gelingt.
de.name: Speicher nicht beschreibbar

en.name: Storage not writable

NO_SAFETY_MEASUREMENT.description: This platform has no safety measurement yet, so it does not drive by itself

KERNEL_CRASH.description: The kernel of the mower crashed; it holds the mower in every state

de.fix: Mäher und Umgebung ansehen, dann den Notaus zurücksetzen. Kommt es öfter vor, die Protokolle für eine Meldung sichern.
de.help: Das Betriebssystem des Mähers ist abgestürzt und neu gestartet. Der Mäher fährt und mäht nicht, bis er freigegeben wird, gleich was er vorher tat.
de.name: Kernel-Absturz

en.fix: Look at the mower and around it, then reset the emergency. If it happens again, keep the logs for a report.
en.help: The operating system of the mower crashed and started again. The mower does not drive or mow until it is released, whatever it did before.
en.name: Kernel crash

NODE_STALLED.description: The watch ended MowBite OS: a node gave no sign within its limit or did not start (stalled in UNEXPECTED_RESTART names it); it holds the mower after a state other than IDLE

de.fix: Mäher und Umgebung ansehen, dann den Notaus zurücksetzen. Kommt es öfter vor, das Protokoll für eine Meldung sichern; das Ereignis nennt den Teil, der hing.
de.help: Ein Teil von MowBite OS hat nicht mehr reagiert, deshalb wurde MowBite OS beendet und neu gestartet. Lief gerade eine Arbeit, wartet der Mäher auf die Freigabe; im Leerlauf geht es von selbst weiter.
de.name: MowBite OS hing

en.fix: Look at the mower and around it, then reset the emergency. If it happens again, keep the log for a report; the event names the part that hung.
en.help: A part of MowBite OS stopped responding, so MowBite OS was ended and started again. If it was working, the mower waits for a release; in IDLE it goes on by itself.
en.name: MowBite OS hung

OS_CRASH.description: MowBite OS ended without its own stop in this boot; it holds the mower after a state other than IDLE

de.fix: Mäher und Umgebung ansehen, dann den Notaus zurücksetzen. Kommt es öfter vor, das Protokoll für eine Meldung sichern.
de.help: MowBite OS wurde ohne eigenen Stopp beendet und neu gestartet (Absturz, beendet, Speicher voll). Lief gerade eine Arbeit, wartet der Mäher auf die Freigabe; im Leerlauf geht es von selbst weiter.
de.name: MowBite OS abgestürzt

en.fix: Look at the mower and around it, then reset the emergency. If it happens again, keep the log for a report.
en.help: MowBite OS ended without its own stop and started again (crash, killed, out of memory). If it was working, the mower waits for a release; in IDLE it goes on by itself.
en.name: MowBite OS crashed

POWER_LOSS.description: The mower started again while MowBite OS ran (power, reset, power key, hang); it holds the mower after a state other than IDLE

de.fix: Mäher und Umgebung ansehen, dann den Notaus zurücksetzen. Im Leerlauf sperrt eine Unterbrechung nicht.
de.help: Der Mäher ist neu gestartet, während MowBite OS lief: Strom weg, Akku raus, harter Reset, Ein-Taste gehalten oder ein Hänger. Jede solche Unterbrechung während der Arbeit sperrt den Mäher bis zur Freigabe. Das ist Absicht, kein Fehler.
de.name: Unterbrechung während der Arbeit

en.fix: Look at the mower and around it, then reset the emergency. In IDLE an interruption holds nothing.
en.help: The mower started again while MowBite OS ran: power cut, battery out, hard reset, power key held or a hang. Any such interruption during work holds the mower until it is released. This is on purpose, not a fault.
en.name: Interrupted while working

APP_API_BREAK.description: The app of the bundle was built for another break of the interface than the OS installed

de.name: App passt nicht

blade.description: The parts of blade_parts in one run, the blade taken off and the wheels without a command. Where hw/capabilities has blade_allowed false, setup.start writes allow_blade for node into the parameter file of the program and restarts the OS (restart of the step): after it a second setup.start runs the step, never the restart itself; a blade the driver still does not allow blocks with BLADE_NOT_ALLOWED. Each part starts the blade at percent and height through the logic (setup/motion blade) until it turns at rpm within spin_up s. on_off: off, it stands (below still_rpm) within off_max s. lease: one request on lease s that is not renewed, the driver switches it off: it stands within lease plus lease_extra s of that request. silent: hw/silence with blade: the board stops it within silent_max s of the answer, then the driver shows emergencies of the list and LATCH only and the program releases them itself. stop, lift and bumper: the user triggers the input of the role within time s: it stands within stop_max s of the input, the emergency of the role follows and the program releases it itself. After every stand nothing turns for hold s, after a release again. A part the step saw nothing of within time asks pressed. Needs the inputs checked standing (SAFETY_INPUTS) and a driver that offers hw/silence; the mower is in IDLE off the charging contacts, without emergency or hold, in the sub state SETUP meanwhile, the blade turns only there and goes off when it ends. setup.start confirms blade_removed and hand_at_stop; setup.keep at least every 1 s keeps it going (else RELEASED).

A board the learning driver held stays held after that restart (HIGH_LEVEL) until emergency.reset. setup.abort ends it with a restart as well. The steps input are open again after it. The step list names how the OS restarts (restart). Once the step is ok setup.answer takes delay_<part> for any of its parts, a whole number of ms from 0 to delay_ms of the part: the table is written with it, the OS restarts and the step holds hw/inputs against it again

de.name: Räder

en.fix: If a wheel turns the wrong way or the wrong one turns, check the plugs of the motors and the settings of the platform.
en.help: The mower is jacked up and turns its wheels slowly forwards, backwards and to both sides. At the end only one wheel turns: tell which one.
en.name: Wheels

speed.description: Speed of the wheels along the part, one value by part with the id of the part

area.description: The map has an area and allows mowing

de.fix: Die Fläche einmal ganz umfahren und speichern.
de.help: Eine Mähfläche aufnehmen. Der Haken kommt, sobald die Karte eine Fläche hat, auf der gemäht werden kann.
de.name: Mähfläche aufnehmen

en.fix: Drive around the whole area once and save it.
en.help: Record an area to mow. The tick comes once the map has an area the mower can mow.
en.name: Record a mowing area

dock_test.description: A docking test ended on the contacts

de.fix: Schlägt der Test fehl, die Station neu aufnehmen und wiederholen.
de.help: Den Andocktest starten. Der Haken kommt, wenn der Mäher von selbst wieder auf den Kontakten steht.
de.name: Andocken testen

en.fix: If the test fails, record the station again and repeat.
en.help: Start the docking test. The tick comes when the mower is back on the contacts by itself.
en.name: Test docking

mow.description: The mower mowed and came back onto the contacts

de.fix: Bleibt der Mäher stehen, zeigt die App den Grund. Danach erneut starten.
de.help: Mähen starten und den Mäher zur Ladestation zurückkehren lassen. Der Haken kommt, wenn er nach dem Mähen wieder auf den Kontakten steht.
de.name: Probelauf

en.fix: If the mower stops, the app shows why. Then start again.
en.help: Start mowing and let the mower return to the docking station. The tick comes when it is back on the contacts after mowing.
en.name: Trial run

ntrip.description: Correction data arrives from the caster

de.fix: Zugangsdaten, Mountpoint und die Internetverbindung des Mähers prüfen.
de.help: Den Zugang zum Korrekturdienst eintragen. Der Haken kommt, sobald Korrekturdaten ankommen.
de.name: Korrekturdaten

en.fix: Check the access data, the mountpoint and the internet connection of the mower.
en.help: Enter the access to the correction service. The tick comes once correction data arrives.
en.name: Correction data

station.description: A docking station is in the map and the mower stands on its contacts

de.fix: Den Mäher gerade auf die Kontakte schieben, bis er lädt, dann die Station aufnehmen.
de.help: Den Mäher auf die Ladestation fahren und die Station aufnehmen. Der Haken kommt, sobald sie in der Karte steht und der Mäher auf den Kontakten ist.
de.name: Ladestation aufnehmen

en.fix: Push the mower straight onto the contacts until it charges, then record the station.
en.help: Drive the mower onto the docking station and record the station. The tick comes once it is in the map and the mower is on the contacts.
en.name: Record the docking station

delay.description: How long the sensor of a part has to stay switched before the hardware stops, at most what the platform gives

de.help: So lange muss der Sensor ausgelöst bleiben, bevor der Mäher stoppt. Kürzer als die Vorgabe geht, länger nicht. Nach einer Änderung startet MowBite OS neu, die Eingänge sind danach neu zu prüfen.
de.name: Verzögerung

en.help: The sensor has to stay triggered this long before the mower stops. Shorter than the default works, longer does not. MowBite OS restarts after a change, the inputs are to be checked again after it.
en.name: Delay

x-setup.description: The setup program: stages in their order, the checks a step of setup/setup.yaml of a platform can be (kind, whether setup.start begins it, params with the bounds and defaults of the code, values, reasons of SETUP_STEP, the screen it opens), roles of the inputs (group, emergency of a press; a role is named as its flag in hw/status) and modes of a part, moves of a step imu, conditions of a step done_when with their screen, points to confirm, reasons to skip, the question of a step inputs_assign and the delays it takes once it is ok, the ways to restart, the parts of a step wheels and its question, the parts of the steps ground and blade, the question pressed of a safety step that saw nothing (a check with safety closes the lock when it fails with a reason that has closes in x-reasons of SETUP_STEP), and the limits; texts by language where the OS has them. The steps themselves come with setup.get

bumper.description: Slowly in bumper_direction against a soft obstacle the user holds, until the bumper stops it

de.help: Der Mäher fährt langsam an. Ein weiches Hindernis vor den Stoßfänger halten und andrücken lassen.
de.name: Stoßfänger

en.help: The mower drives slowly. Hold a soft obstacle against the bumper and let it press.
en.name: Bumper

stop.description: Back towards the start at speed until the user presses STOP

de.help: Der Mäher fährt zurück zum Start. Jetzt die STOP-Taste drücken.
de.name: STOP drücken

en.help: The mower drives back towards the start. Press the STOP button now.
en.name: Press STOP

straight.description: About distance m straight on at speed, then no command: it stands by itself

de.help: Der Mäher fährt etwa 2 m geradeaus und bleibt von selbst stehen.
de.name: Geradeaus

en.help: The mower drives about 2 m straight on and stops by itself.
en.name: Straight on

turn.description: A turn on the spot by angle to the left, then back to the right

de.help: Der Mäher dreht sich auf der Stelle nach links und wieder zurück.
de.name: Drehen

en.help: The mower turns on the spot to the left and back again.
en.name: Turn

assign.description: A part of a step inputs_assign: one line alone changes, and the step asks whether it is the one of the role of the part. Help and fix of such a part; its name is the one of its role

de.fix: Kommt kein Vorschlag: Stecker und Kabel des Sensors prüfen, dann wiederholen.
de.help: Diesen Sensor einmal auslösen und wieder loslassen. Der Mäher zeigt, an welcher Leitung er ihn gesehen hat.
de.name: Zuordnen

en.fix: No proposal: check plug and cable of the sensor, then try again.
en.help: Trigger this sensor once and let go. The mower shows the line it saw it on.
en.name: Assign

press.description: The input switches within the time of the step, the emergency of the step follows within its limit, then the input is let go

short.description: The input switches for less than short_max and no emergency follows: what a bump of the lift sensors must not stop

de.help: Nur kurz auslösen und sofort loslassen: der Mäher darf dabei nicht stoppen.
de.name: Kurz auslösen

en.help: Trigger only briefly and let go at once: the mower must not stop.
en.name: Trigger briefly

front_up.description: The front goes up by the angle tilt

left_up.description: The left side goes up by the angle tilt

right_up.description: The right side goes up by the angle tilt

tilt_stop.description: The mower is tilted until the emergency TILT comes

de.name: Weit kippen, bis der Notaus kommt

en.name: Tilt far until the emergency stop comes

turn_left.description: The mower turns left by the angle turn, seen from above

turn_right.description: The mower turns right by the angle turn

area_clear.description: 3 m are clear in front of and behind the mower, and the user stands next to it at a STOP button

de.name: 3 m frei vor und hinter dem Mäher, ich stehe daneben an der STOP-Taste

en.name: 3 m clear in front of and behind the mower, I stand next to it at the STOP button

clear.description: Nobody is close to the mower

hand_at_stop.description: A hand is at a STOP button, to press it at any time

outdoors.description: The mower stands under the open sky

en.name: Mower stands under the open sky

raised.description: The mower is jacked up, its wheels turn freely

seen_myself.description: The user saw every safety check pass on this mower

de.name: Ich habe jede Sicherheitsprüfung an diesem Mäher selbst gesehen

pressed.description: Whether the user did the action of the part the step saw nothing of

en.help: The mower noticed nothing in time. Did you press, lift or tilt as shown?

host.description: The OS asks its host service for the restart (host.restart_os)

self.description: The OS ends in order and whatever runs it starts it again

bumper.description: The bumper is pressed, on any side

de.help: Den Stoßfänger eindrücken, bis der Haken kommt, und loslassen.
de.name: Stoßfänger

en.fix: No tick: check the switches of the bumper and their cables, then try again.
en.help: Press the bumper in until the tick comes, then let go.
en.name: Bumper

bumper_left.description: The left side of the bumper, on platforms that tell the sides apart

de.fix: Kommt kein Haken: den linken Schalter des Stoßfängers und sein Kabel prüfen, dann wiederholen.
de.help: Den Stoßfänger links eindrücken, bis der Haken kommt, und loslassen.
de.name: Stoßfänger links

en.fix: No tick: check the left switch of the bumper and its cable, then try again.
en.help: Press the bumper in on the left until the tick comes, then let go.
en.name: Bumper left

bumper_right.description: The right side of the bumper, on platforms that tell the sides apart

de.fix: Kommt kein Haken: den rechten Schalter des Stoßfängers und sein Kabel prüfen, dann wiederholen.
de.help: Den Stoßfänger rechts eindrücken, bis der Haken kommt, und loslassen.
de.name: Stoßfänger rechts

en.fix: No tick: check the right switch of the bumper and its cable, then try again.
en.help: Press the bumper in on the right until the tick comes, then let go.
en.name: Bumper right

de.help: Den Mäher anheben, bis der Haken kommt, und wieder absetzen.
de.name: Anheben

en.fix: No tick: check the lift sensors and their cables, then try again.
en.help: Lift the mower until the tick comes, then put it down.
en.name: Lifting

de.fix: Kommt kein Haken: Stecker und Kabel der Taste prüfen, dann wiederholen.
de.help: Jede STOP-Taste einmal drücken und wieder loslassen. Der Mäher muss dabei sofort den Notaus melden.
de.name: STOP-Taste

en.fix: No tick: check plug and cable of the button, then try again.
en.help: Press every STOP button once and let go. The mower has to report the emergency stop at once.
en.name: STOP button
